title: Here’s Why You Don’t Cause Trouble When You Have Outstanding Warrants
description:
On June 17th, 2023, an officer was dispatched regarding a suspicious female who was causing other vehicles to swerve around her. He also discovered that she had a warrant issued in her name. That’s when things began to escalate. The woman kept vomiting, which made the officer think that she was on some kind of narcotic. The officer found some intoxicants in the woman’s bag. The female was charged with obstructing official business and possession of intoxicants.
